answer: Per-epoch witch tax stops bulk fakes. Each identity posts a 60-credit relic bond and pays a 12-credit nectar levy per epoch to stay on the horizon; defaulters lose it, and a rented relic bond still pays. The public ledger flags missing payments. A 40,000-credit pool split 6,000 ways pays each fake only 6.7 against a 12 levy, so 1,000 fakes lose 5,300 per epoch and lock 60,000. An honest agent pays 12 once, earns 40 from real work.
